headline: Indian IT services showed uneven growth with AI driving gains for some firms while others faced modest revenue and profit pressure.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from low single digits to over 50% YoY, led by Coforge and HCLTech on AI‑led deals. Profit margins improved at TCS and HCLTech but fell at Infosys and Wipro. Guidance was trimmed by Infosys and introduced by HCLTech and Wipro. Headcount grew at HCLTech but attrition remained high across the sector.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue expansion
themes.detail: Several firms reported double‑digit AI revenue growth and linked it to larger deal wins.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Operating margins rose above 20% at TCS and Infosys but stayed below 16% at most peers.

themes.title: Guidance adjustments
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance, while HCLTech and Wipro introduced modest outlooks.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
Strong 11.2% revenue growth, high operating margin and AI revenue crossing 10% of total.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance trimmed.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but net profit fell 1.9% and guidance is modest.
